subject: *: remove `mock.NewContext()` usage when building table meta in production code (#56348)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent in `pkg/ddl`, `pkg/infoschema/perfschema`, and `pkg/meta/metabuild`. `ddl.BuildTableInfoFromAST` now requires a caller-supplied `*metabuild.Context`; perf schema init uses `metabuild.NewNonStrictContext()` (SQLMode `ModeNone`) to allow perf schema timestamp defaults like `0000-00-00...`, and sets `TableInfo.State = StatePublic`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in DDL/infoschema/meta correctness, metadata consistency, or schema-state handling.
